sentence: This project studies the capabilities and limitations of neural network models used for numerical analysis and scientific computing.
This project builds a platform for quantum networks using tiny light-emitting defects in diamond that carry quantum information.
This project builds a mathematical model that explains why genetically identical yeast cells differ in how they enter quiescence under stress.
This project uses laser micromachining to make lattice shapes from shape memory alloys and embeds them in rubbery polymers for soft robotics.
This project designs a computing system including a chip and software that detects patterns in data streams while using less energy.
This project studies how resource type affects fighting in female fruit fly species and whether the genetic basis matches that of males.
This project studies how jets, which are narrow sprays of particles, lose energy as they travel through the quark-gluon plasma.
This project develops chemical methods to make long oligonucleotides, segments of DNA and RNA molecules, longer than can be made today.
This project studies fossil specimens and the skeletons of modern species to build the family tree of crocodiles, alligators and their extinct relatives.
This project studies how a bacterial enzyme that methylates DNA causes the strands of DNA to separate at its target site.
This project builds deep learning tools that predict how proteins move and change shape over time from their amino acid sequence.
This project studies how nutrients and interactions between phytoplankton cells and bacteria control the timing of phytoplankton blooms in a coastal ecosystem.
This project builds soft robots that use living neurons and piezoionic hydrogels to sense touch and turn it into signals.
